name: Apocalypse Mutant 2
source:
A whole new story in the apocalyptic world that followed the great nuclear war.
Lead a team of outcast mutants, hunted by humans and nuke-zombies, who decide to come together and become the hunters.
Make decisions in search of freedom, fame, love and adventure. Be their instinct and decide their fate.
Four misfit mutants with different origins team up with a common goal: move forward in a world that has turned its back on them,
and reveal the truth about the free city of New Lisbon.
They'll have to face marauders, anti-mutant cults, and beasts degenerated by nuclear radiation, while their team and their difficulties grow.
And while enjoying the trip, for this is the end of time.
Sex, humor and drama in the second parody of the Apocalypse Mutant world.
